values: /create-prd wrapper 2026-05-17: PRD-002 — Bento-grid pretty UI redesign of /full-page on the SHIPPED paywall-blueprint product.
Operator discovery answers 2026-05-17 (visual mood: sophisticated data viz / layout: UI Designer proposes 2 / animation: CSS+Recharts no new deps / theme: always visible in topbar).
Operator follow-up 2026-05-17: 'Could we bring in some sitecore related features into the list as well?'
Operator post-critical-review direction 2026-05-17: 'Let us stick to what we know. ... On the premium let us get fancy and fake it till we make it ... no need for real data if this is a big unknown.'

extension_points.notes: Inherited from PRD-000/001; PRD-002 replaces the freemium demo content at /full-page with a bento-grid dashboard. Same route, same extension point registration.

stage_history.notes: Gap-focused discovery (light-to-standard pacing). 4 questions via AskUserQuestion: visual mood (sophisticated data viz), layout strategy (UI Designer proposes 2), animation library (CSS+Recharts, no new deps), theme toggle visibility (always visible in topbar). Operator follow-up: add Sitecore-related features.
Operator confirmed: real Sitecore data on free tier; original premium plan was real+fake mix.

PRD-002 + prd-minimal-002 written. Originally proposed real+fake premium mix with 2 new API routes (/api/activity, /api/payments) and 3 new SDK surfaces. PM critical review (standard rigor) surfaced 3 BLOCKERs + 5 HIGHs + 10 MEDIUMs. Operator post-review direction: 'stick to what we know; fake premium' — PRD revised to ALL-FAKE premium tier, dropped both new API routes, dropped xmc.authoring.graphql, kept xmc.sites.listSites as the only new SDK call. Net scope shrink ~40%, zero big unknowns. 3 new ADRs (0016 theme toggle visibility, 0017 processed_events tenant_id, 0018 premium fake-data posture).

operator_attention.item: Premium bento cards SHIP 100% FAKE (no API fetches, no SDK calls, no database queries at any state). Operator direction 2026-05-17: 'fake it till we make it'. ADR-0018 captures the showcase posture + adopter-hardening note. Original draft proposed real+fake mix; PM critical review surfaced unknown Authoring GraphQL schema as BLOCKER 3; revised PRD drops `xmc.authoring.graphql` entirely.

Theme toggle always visible in topbar (ADR-0016). Departs from `feedback_dark_mode_default_policy.md` env-gating pattern. Justified as showcase posture; adopters env-gate for production (README 'Production hardening for adopters' section, Tranche E).

`processed_events.tenant_id` column added in Tranche A operator SQL block (ADR-0017). Nullable; pre-migration rows stay NULL. Webhook handler one-line update writes tenant_id on insert. F4 query trivially filters by tenant_id.

`xmc.sites.listSites` response shape assumed per `sitecore:marketplace-sdk-xmc` skill (double `.data.data` unwrap envelope). Captured at Tranche A real-tenant smoke; fix inline if differs. Progressive-fixture-capture per `feedback_assumed_shapes_progressive_capture.md`. ONLY new SDK call in PRD-002.

OA-002-1: Cloud Portal app registration must have `xmc.sites.*` API access scope enabled. Operator pre-flight at Tranche A start. If scope unavailable/named-differently/requires-approval, capture actual scope name and update PRD; fallback: F2 ships with 'Not available' state (R1).

Recharts dep added in Tranche A (`npm install recharts`). ~80-100kb gzipped. Lazy-loaded via dynamic import for premium-only chunk so free-tier first paint is unaffected. NFR-1 budget revised: free-tier delta ≤ 50kb gzipped; premium chunk separately measured (R8).

PM critical review (standard rigor) found 3 BLOCKERs + 5 HIGHs + 10 MEDIUMs + 1 LOW. Operator chose 'accept all' direction. All 19 findings folded into PRD-002 revision: Authoring GraphQL deferred (BLOCKER 3 resolved by 'fake premium'); placeholder shapes in locked state (BLOCKER 2); processed_events.tenant_id locked as Option A (BLOCKER 1 — ADR-0017); FR-2.4 F4 fresh-tenant empty state added; US-7 doc-theater dropped (folded into NFR-10); AC1.6 made testable (1.6a+1.6b); FR-5.2 stagger-in DOM-order = reading-order; FR-6.1 blur strengthened (filter+opacity+pointer-events); NFR-1 Recharts lazy-load; R5 split into R5a/R5b; theme toggle policy note in ADR-0016; FR-3.6 AIInsights heuristics moot (fake bullets); FR-4.1/4.2 input validation moot (no new API routes); test:no-hex-in-bento at Tranche A; scope name fallback added to R1; AllowedState/NoSubscriptionState relationship clarified (bento at page.tsx level); TenantIdBadge/PaywallVersionOverride footnote added.
operator_attention.references: PM critical review subagent (2026-05-17); PRD-002 revision

notes: PRD-002 is a feature PRD on the SHIPPED paywall-blueprint product (PRD-000 + PRD-001 both shipped to production at https://sitecore-plugin-paywall-blueprint.vercel.app/ as of 2026-05-17).
Branched from main (no stacked-PRD detection: PRD-001 merged + closed before PRD-002 kicked off).
discovery_level: standard (gap-focused since detailed wrapper brief; 4 questions via AskUserQuestion + 1 operator follow-up)

sdk_surface_split: declined — originally 3 new SDK surfaces flagged, but after operator's post-review direction the count dropped to 1 (`xmc.sites.listSites` only). Well under the 3+ heuristic threshold.

scope_dial inferred from wrapper signal 'rigor=standard, track=full, ui_variants=2 or 3, docs_at_ship=auto-lite, task_breakdown_review=skip_gate'. ui_variants picked as 2 (cheaper than 3 while still giving operator divergence at /architect).

PRD-002 net scope vs original draft: ~40% smaller after operator's 'fake premium' direction. Dropped /api/activity, /api/payments, xmc.authoring.graphql, all real premium data fetches. Kept xmc.sites.listSites as the only new SDK call. Net code surface: bento components + theme toggle + one-line webhook update + one Supabase migration.
